CustomField.description: Value of Commissionable_Window__c Months past First Bill Date (Closedate) CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date.
CustomField.formula: DATE( year(IM_Booked_Date__c) + floor((month(IM_Booked_Date__c) + Commissionable_Window__c)/12) + if(and(month(IM_Booked_Date__c)=12,Commissionable_Window__c>=12),-1,0) , if( mod( month(IM_Booked_Date__c) + Commissionable_Window__c , 12 ) = 0, 12 , mod( month(IM_Booked_Date__c) + Commissionable_Window__c , 12 )) , min( day(IM_Booked_Date__c), case( max( mod( month(IM_Booked_Date__c) + Commissionable_Window__c , 12 ) , 1), 9,30, 4,30, 6,30, 11,30, 2,28, 31 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Commissionable Window Close Date
